art.method: Official achimala DreamLoop, exact native camera anchor, generated target, private implementation, independent fresh critique.

scope.controlled: Frozen draw poses and cache transitions; four native optic overlay cases suppress the viewmodel.

controls.method: Real R/digit keys, mouse fire/kick and RAF. Isolated setup inventories; no gameplay balance claim. Same-build cache ghost comparison, not old visual parity.

bmg.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (0x00009BC8) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
bmg.scope: One headless Chrome process; isolated fresh contexts in ABBA then BAAB; deterministic seed and chapter0 starting camera; enemies removed equally. Two real-R warmups followed by six real-R measured reloads/context. QA resets magazine/reserve only between reloads. CPU samples cover h0t Sniper draws with a native reload pose; RAF intervals span the input-to-completion measurement window. Whole-build shared-host observation, not isolated bolt-glove cost or campaign FPS.

nativeClips.name: bmg

audio.source: Existing game WebAudio output tapped after master; encoded audio copied into final container.

nativeClips.controls: Stock 5 key then actual R/native RAF and post-master WebAudio output. QA supplies selected BMG/reserve and removes enemies; subtitles hidden. No scripted view pose.

sync.scope: Audio starts when the preroll marker is removed; trim uses the first non-marker video frame. Video frame granularity is 40ms; physical audio-output latency is not measured.
